Best lunch in Ho Chi Minh City
Jan 2019 • Friends
My friend and I stumbled upon this restaurant after visiting the 
Museum of Art ( 2 minute walk). We were planning to have coffee, but were enticed by the wonderful aromas and decided to have lunch. So glad we did. The manager recommended the vermicelli bowl with marinated, char-grilled pork and Spring roll. He said it was a Saigon specialty. It was my favorite meal in Ho Chi Minh City. If you are looking for great food at a very affordable price, then you will not be disappointed.
